mintAuthority.summary: Ethereum HadronToken and Celo CeloOFTExtension expose independent owner-only mint and redeem functions. Each token and its transparent ProxyAdmin are controlled immediately by a local legacy 3-of-5 multisig, with the same five signer addresses on both chains. Celo's separate OFT-authorized crosschain mint/burn and messaging controls are reviewed under Bridge Risk, not substituted for the native owner-only mint.

controls.label: USAT owner-only minter
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095794, token owner() and ProxyAdmin owner() both returned this address. required() returned 3 and getOwners() returned five signer slots: 0x6744a526c21015f46559083cbc1984cc23138af2, 0x106743fde530388d0e4963d28189e8868f151511, 0xd3fc71bde8a7e6c6f8b5665c2398e5dca025c680, 0x682986313e971e197d1afe75f07c54c0e0f8dbc9, and 0x1e1ed3720091fbe7f3ee178fe63e9633641fd58d. Re-fetched HadronToken source confirms owner-only mint, redeem, and destroyBlockedFunds functions. Correct EIP-1967 implementation/admin slots retained the reviewed implementation and ProxyAdmin.

controls.label: USAT Celo owner-only minter
controls.evidence: At Celo block 78972418, token owner() and token ProxyAdmin 0x407cea8bc0b1c42a72a1f38e3c8e60a3929f7422 owner() return this wallet. required()=3; getOwners() has the same five addresses as the Ethereum owner's roster. Verified CeloOFTExtension inherits TetherToken's owner-only mint(address,uint256), independent of OFTExtension's authorized crosschainMint. Token implementation is 0x49912f84f43d2675d99941b7f21a5d9ed2eab71e. The legacy wallet has no mandatory execution delay or Safe modules.

sources.label: OCC active national banks as of August 31, 2026

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526649, the EIP-1967 implementation and admin slots resolved to implementation 0x8b98bcd9b1f8ae112fb2b58b45c3bc9a75cc4d0e and ProxyAdmin 0x3e4c6460aa00c11c81e3c5b95b15d612f5f2d9c7. ProxyAdmin.owner() and token owner() both returned the same reviewed legacy multisig, whose current required() value is 3 and getOwners() returned five signers. The verified HadronToken source confirms owner-only mint and redeem authority; ProxyAdmin source exposes immediate owner-only upgrades with no timelock. On 2026-07-15, Anchorage's primary transparency page listed monthly Big Four AICPA attestations for January through May 2026 and identified Anchorage Digital Bank N.A. as issuer; the OCC's current institution list independently confirmed the active national bank. USAT is therefore periodically reconciled and prudentially supervised, while its no-delay issuer-controlled mint is economically unbounded.
